persona: Enterprise network engineer who moved onto Azure networking
resumeText:
Rohit Deshmukh | Pune | rohit.deshmukh@example.com

SUMMARY
Network engineer with 8 years in enterprise routing, the last 3 years on Azure networking.

EXPERIENCE
Network Engineer, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (2020 - present)
- Built hub-and-spoke VNets with Azure Firewall for 30 application subscriptions.
- Set up Azure ExpressRoute circuits and site-to-site VPN backup to the Pune data centre.
- Configured BGP peering and route filters between on-premises routers and Azure.
- Troubleshot DNS resolution and TCP/IP issues between branch offices and cloud workloads.
- Wrote network segmentation rules and VPN policies for PCI workloads.

Network Support Engineer, Deccan Netlink, Pune (2018 - 2020)
- Managed Cisco switches and VLANs across 12 branch sites.
- Monitored links with SolarWinds and handled L2 tickets.

SKILLS
Azure, BGP, OSPF, Cisco IOS, Terraform (basic)

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Telecommunication, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2018

CERTIFICATIONS
CCNA (2019)
